_comment: ADR-090 §Roster preset — default seven-member epic-team. Resolved by `spawn-epic` when no --roster / --roster-file flag is passed (§Decision-anchor #4). Operators ship custom presets by dropping <name>.json files into templates/epic-rosters/ and referencing them via --roster <name>. The roster array MERGES into a synthesised Team object at spawn time (name + tmuxTmpdir + epicTeam block + worktreeInitSubmodules:true + worktreeIsolation:false are filled in by the verb); loadTeam validates the synthesised object before disk write.
